summary: All six brief requirements and the frozen AC are present and match the spec; stricter display hardening for format/control characters is documented in the contract, not a divergence.

ac_verdicts.reason: File and event pointers parse into structured kinds; parseEvidence gives them their quote, shown first as plain-text labels; the copy guard uses the quote as a needle (400 line_contains_quote on an unedited line); auditEvidence writes {form:'file',...} / {form:'event',id} and never the quote.
